findings.claim: S3 getDataWithMetadata reports the first part's Content-Length as the object length, so objects over 8 MiB uploaded in parts get a truncated length.
findings.failure_mode: If merged as-is, on S3 storage (multipartEnabled defaults to true) a complex obs over 8 MiB reports length 8388608; legacyui's ComplexObsServlet sets that as Content-Length, so downloads stop at 8 MiB. Master used HEAD, which gives the full size.
findings.evidence: SDK 2.32.13 sources (resolved via dependency:list): DownloadObjectHelper.downloadObject splits a non-ranged GetObject into partNumber requests; SplittingTransformer.onResponse forwards only the first part's response upstream (onResponseCalled CAS); MultipartDownloaderSubscriber.requestMoreIfNeeded treats response.contentLength() as that part's bytes and uses partsCount to fetch more; DEFAULT_MIN_PART_SIZE = 8 MiB. S3StorageService constructor: multipartEnabled default true. Throwaway test with mocked S3AsyncClient returning a part-1 GetObjectResponse (contentLength 8388608, contentRange 'bytes 0-8388607/20971520'): head reports 8388608; with the suggested fix 20971520, single-part responses unchanged (5). Suggestion run through spotless:apply (no change) and handler/storage tests (70) green. javap of legacyui-omod 3.0.0-SNAPSHOT ComplexObsServlet: ComplexData.getLength -> setHeader Content-Length.

findings.claim: read() falls back to the legacy location only on NoSuchFileException, so a legacy obs whose encoded name exceeds 255 bytes fails with 'File name too long' instead of being read from the legacy location as master does.
findings.failure_mode: If merged as-is, pre-2.8 complex obs with titles of 36+ Cyrillic letters (about 24+ Ethiopic characters) stop loading once storage/complex_obs exists (any obs saved under the new layout): AbstractHandler throws UncheckedIOException, TextHandler/BinaryDataHandler throw APIException, ImageHandler silently returns no image. The ticket requires legacy-layout reads to be preserved.
findings.evidence: Throwaway LocalStorageService test: legacy file appdata/complex_obs/<title>_<uuid>.txt, key 'complex_obs/<name>', storage/complex_obs present. Titles of 6, 35 Cyrillic and 21 Ethiopic chars (encoded 49/253/232 bytes) read fine; 36 Cyrillic (259 bytes) -> java.nio.file.FileSystemException ... File name too long at head, while master's predicate Files.newInputStream(getPath(key)) reads it. Without storage/complex_obs the miss is ENOENT and the fallback works (control). Legacy naming confirmed in df94143ec^ AbstractHandler.java:65. Suggested read() applied: 36-char case reads, spotless only drops the unused NoSuchFileException import, LocalStorageServiceTest + 6 handler tests green.

findings.claim: The call-count test only covers AbstractHandler.getObs, which every bundled handler overrides, so the ticket's guard against reintroducing redundant calls does not reach the code that serves reads.
findings.failure_mode: If merged as-is, TRUNK-6682's acceptance criterion (tests preventing reintroduction of redundant probes) is unmet: re-adding exists() or a separate getMetadata to any bundled handler passes CI.
findings.evidence: Mutation: added storageService.exists(key) to BinaryStreamHandler, replaced dwm.metadata() with storageService.getMetadata(key) in TextHandler, and with the 2-arg injectMissingMetadata in BinaryDataHandler; LocalStorageServiceTest + AbstractHandler/Text/Media/BinaryStream/Image/BinaryData tests: 68 run, 0 failures. Positive control: same 2-arg mutation in AbstractHandler.getObs turns getObs_shouldNotIssueRedundantStorageCallsForLocalStorage red (expected 0 but was 1). All five handlers declare getObs overrides; AbstractHandler fields adminService/storageService are package-private @Autowired, handlers have no-arg constructors.

findings.claim: exists() no longer checks that the current-location path stays inside the storage dir, so it reports existence of arbitrary absolute paths where master threw IllegalArgumentException.
findings.evidence: Throwaway test at head: exists('/etc/passwd')=true, exists('/etc/nope-xyz')=false; master's predicate Files.exists(getPath('/etc/passwd')) throws IAE 'outside legacy storage dir'; getData('/etc/passwd') still IAE. My draft's narrower fix still left false-vs-IAE; revised suggestion gives IAE for both, false for a missing relative key; spotless no change; LocalStorageServiceTest (incl. exists_shouldCheckExistenceOnceWhenFileIsInStorageDir) + AbstractHandler/TextHandler tests green (46).

findings.claim: S3 getData duplicates the GetObject request and 404 translation that getDataWithMetadata now does.
findings.evidence: Read S3StorageService.java:129-156 at head: identical request builder, toBlockingInputStream transformer and translateNotFound. Applied the suggestion: compiles, spotless leaves it unchanged, storage/handler tests green. Precedent: thread discussion_r3990739410 in the conversation snapshot.
findings.body:
This can just delegate to `getDataWithMetadata`, which repeats the same GetObject call and 404 translation (the duplication ibacher flagged in `LocalStorageService`, [comment](https://github.com/openmrs/openmrs-core/pull/6535#discussion_r3990739410)). Optional, but it keeps the two from drifting:

```suggestion
		return getDataWithMetadata(key).data();
```

dropped_drafts.reason: The obsDir null guard is three lines plus one test fixing a real pre-existing NPE (String.replaceFirst(null, ...)); asking to split it out costs the author a round trip for little review saving, so it is not worth a comment.

verdict: Not ready to merge: the S3 combined read reports a truncated length for multipart objects over 8 MiB, and legacy obs with long non-ASCII titles stop loading locally.
what_i_swept: Confirmed diff stat (17 files, +692/-69; head lacks one bom/pom.xml change on master, irrelevant). Read ticket (incl. backport label and acceptance criteria), PR body, and every prior thread; confirmed silently that greptile's ABI, URI_VIEW and formatting points, ibacher's LocalStorageService/AbstractHandler/BinaryDataHandler points and the ImageHandler filename regression are fixed at head. Read every changed file in full. Outward trace: legacy 2.7 file naming (df94143ec^), BaseStorageService.encodeKey, AbstractHandler.parseDataKey's exists probe, getPath's remaining callers (purgeData only), the AWS SDK 2.32.13 multipart download path, and legacyui's ComplexObsServlet (javap) as the consumer of ComplexData length. Ran throwaway tests for D1/D2/D4, a handler mutation for D3 with a positive control, and applied every suggested fix with spotless:apply plus the storage/handler tests. Three passes; the third found nothing new.
could_not_verify: D1 against a real S3 bucket: needs access. The part-1 Content-Length behaviour rests on the SDK 2.32.13 sources and a mocked client, not a live multipart GET; S3StorageServiceIT (S3Mock via Testcontainers) was not run.
D2 on Linux: reproduced on macOS APFS; Linux ext4 returns the same ENAMETOOLONG errno but was not run here.
The GitHub links in D2 and D6 were not opened (web disabled); the commit df94143ec and comment id 3990739410 were checked against the clone and the conversation snapshot.
